messages.content: Calculate 31*17. Reply only with the integer.
Calculate 57*13-29. Reply only with the integer.
Calculate three quarters of 120 plus one fifth of 80. Reply only with the integer.
Calculate 456*23. Reply only with the integer.
Calculate 100-17*3. Reply only with the integer.
A bag contains 2 red, 3 blue and 5 white balls. One is chosen uniformly. What is the probability of blue? Reply only as a reduced fraction a/b.
What does Python sum(x*x for x in range(1,6)) evaluate to? Reply only with the integer.
What is the value of "abcdef"[1:5:2] in Python? Reply only with the two letters, no quotes.
Start with Python list ["a","b"]. Append "c", then remove "b". Reply only with the resulting JSON array.
Remove duplicates and sort ascending: 5,1,5,2,3,2. Reply only with a JSON array.
How many 1 bits are in the binary representation of decimal 45? Reply only with the integer.
For {"people":[{"age":5},{"age":7}]}, sum all ages. Reply only with the integer.
Rows are (A,3),(B,5),(A,4). Group by letter and sum the numbers. Reply only with a JSON object.
For {"a":{"items":[4,7,11]}}, what is a.items[1] using zero-based indexing? Reply only with the integer.
Bob is before Ana. Cara is after Ana. What is their order? Reply only with a JSON array of names.
All cats are mammals. All mammals are warm-blooded. Does it follow that all cats are warm-blooded? Reply only YES or NO.
A check fails if B OR C is true. B is false and C is false. Does the check PASS or FAIL? Reply only PASS or FAIL.
